parameters: \C[6]Quillhaven\C[0] - Royal Magic Academy of Nova
East: the coast road, south to the Royal Capital.
\C[6]Notice Board\C[0]
"Rooms for students' families - ask at the Inkpot."
"LOST: one familiar (toad). Answers to Bartholomew."
"Fresh eggs daily - knock at the coop, not the hens."
\C[6]QUILL & CANDLE - Books, ink and spell paper\C[0]
"Closed for stocktaking. Back tomorrow."
A student's mother answers through the door:
"If you're selling charms, we have plenty!"
The door is locked. Someone inside is practising
a spell... badly. Something just popped.
The door is locked. It smells of fresh bread.
An old voice: "The door's stuck again. Come back later."
A note on the door: "Gone to the Academy to lecture. Feed the cat."
The coop smells of straw and indignation.
\C[6]Academy Sentinel:\C[0]
The Royal Magic Academy of Nova.
Visitors may see the Great Hall and the Cloister Court.
The dormitories are for students only.
\C[6]Student:\C[0]
Third-year exams start next week.
If I fail Wards again, my mother will turn me into a toad.
...She can, you know. She graduated top of her year.
\C[6]Student:\C[0]
I keep counting the windows on the east wing.
Thirteen from outside. Twelve from inside.
Nobody will tell me why.
\C[6]Student:\C[0]
Graduates leave as Class 5, or Class 4 if the
examiners like you. Then it's missions and more exams.
\C[6]Old Scholar:\C[0]
Forty years I taught Runes up there.
Now I sit by this well and correct the children's spelling.
The runes, I mean. Their spelling is hopeless too.
\C[6]Pedlar:\C[0]
Quills, candle-ends, lucky beetles!
The students buy anything before an exam.
\C[6]Hen-wife Bess:\C[0]
The Academy kitchens take every egg I have.
Something about a professor who eats nine a day.
Nine! I don't ask.
\C[6]Farmer:\C[0]
The apothecary buys my mandrakes. Ten silver a root.
Earplugs are extra.
\C[6]Child:\C[0]
When I grow up I'll go to the Academy
and make the carrots dance!
\C[6]Child:\C[0]
Tag! You're it!
\C[6]Washerwoman:\C[0]
Robes, robes and more robes.
Do you know how hard it is to get scorch marks out of velvet?
The hen eyes you suspiciously.
Cluck.
The hen pecks at your boot.
The cat is watching the pond. Possibly for Bartholomew.
